title: Recreating a Pokemon ability into a passive state

posts.author: CSpringer205
posts.body: I've been doing some research on Lucario's abilities, and I'm interested in incorporating them into passive states for a game. One of his abilities, Inner Focus, prevents him from being flinched. To reflect this, I plan to reduce the chance of him being stunned to 50%. However, I'm unsure how to implement the other ability, Steadfast, which increases his speed each time he gets flinched. I would really appreciate any assistance with this. Thank you.

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
with yanfly's buffs and states plugin, give your flinch state the following notetag
Code:
<custom apply effect>
if (user.isStateAffected(x))
  user.addBuff(6, 5);
</custom apply effect>
and replace the x with the id for the steadfast state.
then any time the stunned state is applied to a battler with the passive, they gain a speed buff for 5 turns
EDIT: i saw the Primarily used engine was MV, but just incase. is this for MV or MZ?
